params.prompt: Use the exact art style of the reference images. In-game screenshot of a stylized 3D exploration RPG seen from a fixed high top-down three-quarter camera pitched steeply down about 60 degrees: no horizon and no sky, the ground fills the entire frame. In the center, small, about one eighth of the image height: a chibi engineering student with voluminous dark curly hair, khaki utility jacket, cargo pants and a brown crossbody tool bag walks along a winding dirt footpath, with a small gray-and-cream cat wearing a glowing cyan collar tag at their side. Setting: a grassy clearing of a tropical dry-forest park at the foot of a hill, late afternoon. Tufts of tall grass, wildflowers, mossy faceted boulders, the wide canopy of a ceibo tree, a green iguana basking on a rock, a small stream crossed by a plank bridge, the first steps of a mosaic stair in one corner. A rusty fallen satellite dish and an old solar panel lie half hidden in the grass, each with a faint cyan sparkle marking it as collectible. Long soft shadows, warm light, cool teal shade. Stylized low-poly 3D, faceted flat-shaded planes with hand-painted gradients, cel-shaded light with rim light, matte materials. No text, no logos, no interface.
